rejected_rule.statement: A co-owner who has been granted leave and licence to possess a divided lot of land can be estopped from claiming prescriptive title to that land if they have subsequently alienated their plot of land by deeds.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: As such the said co-owners dividedly and separately possessed there plots of land. The Defendant had admitted this position, and deeds me25 me26, me 27 &, me28 in cross-examination.
